lines.text: Is Shell V Power gas worth 50 cents more per gallon than the cheap stuff?
So he runs a generator on each gas and lets a space heater drain the tank.
And it runs 71 minutes on each so there's zero gain in fuel efficiency.
Because that engine is built for 87 octane so the fancy fuel just burns the same way.
But then he soaks two greasy bolts in each gas overnight.
The Shell turns much darker because its extra detergents pull the grime off and hold it in the fuel.
beats: ai:tiny glowing detergent molecules pulling black grime off a metal bolt in golden fuel macro

lines.text: And on paper the cheap gas bolt leaves way more dirt behind.
So Shell really does clean better which helps keep an engine clean inside over time.
But a cheap bottle of fuel cleaner from the store does the same job.
beats: ai:a hand pouring a bottle of fuel system cleaner into the gas filler of a car in bright daylight sharp focus

lines.text: So the extra 50 cents a gallon just isn't worth it.
Would you still pay for premium?
